usage: The word '蟲' is used as a noun to refer to insects generally.
You can use '蟲' to talk about anything from tiny flies to big beetles.
'蟲' can appear alone or combined with other words to specify different types of insects.
When asking about insects, '蟲' is the base word you'll use.
It's common to see '蟲' in sentences describing nature or when discussing pests.
